mapper.select:
select a.*, idt.name type_name, ig.name gateway_name, ig.type gateway_type, ip.code protocol_code , ip.name protocol_name, ip.ctrl_mode, ip.type transport_protocol, count(distinct id.id) device_count from iot_product a left join iot_product_type idt on a.product_type_id=idt.id left join iot_gateway ig on a.gateway_id=ig.id left join iot_protocol ip on ip.id = a.protocol_id left join iot_device id on id.product_id=a.id
and a.gateway_id=#{entity.gatewayId}
and a.protocol_id=#{entity.protocolId}
and find_in_set(#{entity.productTypeId}, idt.path)
and a.name like '%${entity.name}%'
and a.code like '%${entity.code}%'
group by a.id
